tasks.instruction: Dla kazdego ze zdan utworz slowo pochodne od slowa bazowego zapisanego wielkimi literami. Wymagana jest pelna poprawnosc ortograficzna.

items.sentence: He __________ ignored the speed limit sign and had to pay a huge fine.
__________ twins have to share every aspect of their life, including working together.
__________, a natural response of your body to stress, is a feeling of fear or apprehension about future events.
"Not in a million years" — the idiom is used to talk about something which is __________ to happen.
Children and teenagers have a natural __________ about things related to science.
An entirely vegan diet is claimed to be __________ better for the environment than the Mediterranean one.
What is the most __________ building you have ever visited?
Being a highly __________ person, she hardly ever gets bored.
Our calculations are based on the __________ that the prices will rise.
A serious __________ of cybersecurity experts might result in enormous losses of many companies.
